thesis: Howard Marks explains that his investment memos originated from specific events rather than a grand plan and were written to communicate his investment philosophy with clarity rather than financial jargon. He emphasizes that his approach focuses on investor psychology and sentiment, noting that being ahead of one's time is often indistinguishable from being wrong.
